checks: TPS and confirmation rate share verified 600 s counts
mean and P95 share the exact same transaction sample and source event SHA-256
all methods/settings have one independent run
window: [0,600 s) since first actual dispatch in each run
latency_selection: first N hashes in original input order among the three-way final-confirmation intersection
p95_definition: sorted per-transaction latency at one-based rank ceil(0.95 * sample size)
